name: swift-foundation
description: Shared Swift foundation skills for the SDLC marketplace: swift-conventions (Swift 6 language mode, value types, optionals, typed errors, protocols and generics, strict concurrency — actors, Sendable, MainActor default isolation), swift-tooling (SwiftPM manifests and dependencies, swift build/test, xcodebuild basics, swift-format / SwiftFormat / SwiftLint, Tuist / XcodeGen) and swift-testing (Swift Testing @Test/#expect, XCTest, async tests, test doubles, coverage). Referenced by swift-plugin and apple-plugin. No agent, no stack profile — pure shared library.
